one_line: Full-featured CRM by Zoho with a REST API (v6) covering sales, marketing, service, and custom modules.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with client id/secret (self-client flow for your own org, or standard authorization-code flow for apps); scopes like ZohoCRM.modules.ALL. Developer edition available for integration testing.
self_serve_notes: Free Developer Edition org provides full API access for testing; standard editions start with a free trial. Self-serve signup, no sales contact.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: API v6 covering all CRM modules, custom modules, custom functions, blueprint, notes, tasks, and attachments
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks/connections supported for module record events and notifications

existing_mcp.note: Zoho has published official MCP servers for its apps including CRM; community servers also exist. Marked with some uncertainty.

evidence.note: No fetched text file for app 7; facts from knowledge of the platform plus official docs URL. Confidence medium.

agent_notes: No text file fetched for this app - all fields from knowledge. OAuth client setup and developer edition provisioning add some setup time.
